composition_rows.component_objects: Archive manifests, generated summaries, provenance records, and package files.
composition_rows.composition_rule: Package composition records custody and indexing relationships only; it is not a physical, mathematical, or candidate-native composition law.
composition_rows.associativity_or_functoriality_test: Packaging can be checked for file inclusion and generated-surface consistency, but this does not test physical functoriality or sector composition.
composition_rows.non_compositional_failure_mode: A clean package can coexist with incompatible theory sectors, failed interfaces, missing public-record bridges, or noncomposable evidence units.
composition_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer physical composition, unification, modular closure, or candidate identity from manifest/package composition.
